description: Estimates how much of a team's work AI could take on today, as full-time roles' worth of tasks, from headcount in seven role groups, ordered by the Department for Education's exposure ranking. Measures tasks, not people. Free, no key. Docs: https://aeolookup.com/ai-calculators/will-ai-replace-my-staff/

admin.description: How many people work as admin, reception and office support (default 0).

customer.description: How many people work as customer service and phone sales (default 0).

finance.description: How many people work as bookkeeping, payroll and finance admin (default 0).

handson.description: How many people work as hands-on staff (trades, care, kitchen, warehouse, drivers) (default 0).

managers.description: How many people work as managers and directors (default 0).

marketing.description: How many people work as marketing and content (default 0).

professional.description: How many people work as professionals (accountants, solicitors, consultants, analysts) (default 0).

name: estimate_ai_staff_impact
title: Will AI replace my staff?
